title: New Relic License key: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]
summary: Synthetic New Relic License key values built to the documented format appear in 6 inputs in container and orchestration configuration, environment files, HTTP headers, SDK and client configuration, shell exports, and structured files (JSON, YAML, TOML). Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
